case.question: How long are Artemis III astronauts expected to spend on the lunar surface?
case.gold_answer: Artemis III astronauts are expected to spend up to 6.5 days on the lunar surface.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 1: artemis_surface_duration | Artemis III surface stay
retrieved.text: Artemis III astronauts are expected to spend up to 6.5 days on the lunar surface, living inside the HLS crew cabin before launching back to lunar orbit.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 2: artemis_science_objectives | Seven Artemis III science objectives
retrieved.text: The seven overarching Artemis III science objectives are understanding planetary processes, understanding the character and origin of lunar polar volatiles, interpreting the impact history of the Earth-Moon system, revealing the record of the ancient sun and astronomical environment, observing the universe and local space environment from a unique location, conducting experimental science in the lunar environment, and investigating and mitigating exploration risks.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 3: artemis_geology_training | Apollo-style geology training
retrieved.text: The report recommends that astronauts participate in an Apollo-style geology and planetary science course and that an Earth-based Artemis III Science Mission Center provide real-time support.
